name: agent-harness-hardening
description: Audit and harden the runtime permission boundary of an agent harness: execution sandbox, filesystem scope, network egress, credential reach, tool and MCP surface, and approval and audit coverage.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and tighten an agent harness permission boundary
interface.longDescription: Review the runtime permission boundary that an agent harness actually enforces — sandbox mode, filesystem scope, network egress, credential reach, tool and MCP server surface, and approval and audit coverage — then produce an evidence-backed hardening plan with exact config deltas and a verification command for each change.
defaultPrompt: Audit my agent harness configuration and show me where the blast radius is too wide.
Review the effective Codex config layers for sandbox and approval gaps.
Design an approval policy and audit log spec for this agent's tool set.
